chunks: From him, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'a, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who has a female slave and has sexual relations with her; is it permissible for him to marry her daughter? He said: No. She is as Allah the Exalted said: 'Your step-daughters who are in your households'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to marry the daughter of your female slave after having relations with her?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that sexual intercourse with a female slave (concubine) establishes a permanent prohibition (mahramiyyah) against marrying her daughter, extending the Quranic rule of step-daughters to include concubines. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the bond of 'possession' (imlik) via intercourse creates the same marital-like prohibition as formal marriage, ensuring lineage and family structure are preserved.
